Downtown Chicago offers a rich mix of world‑class museums, iconic architecture, green spaces, and waterfront attractions that fit together into a cohesive visit plan. Start with the Art Institute of Chicago and “The Bean” in Millennium Park, then stroll the Chicago Riverwalk for dining and public art [d1,d4]. Architecture lovers should book a Chicago Architecture Foundation Center River Cruise to see about 50 iconic buildings from the water [d1,d4]. For skyline views, step onto The Ledge at Skydeck in Willis Tower [d4]. Navy Pier is another must‑see for events, rides, dining, and lake views [d9]. If you prefer curated passes or free tours, CityPASS can bundle top attractions at a discount and Chicago Greeter offers free neighborhood tours led by locals [d1,d4].
